matches.title: Olympique Marseille vs Paris FC
matches.description: Watch Marseille vs Paris FC highlights and goals from Ligue 1 on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on September 6, 2026. The Ligue 1 clash between Olympique Marseille and Paris FC on September 6, 2026, was anticipated as a high-stakes tactical encounter. From the opening whistle, both teams demonstrated an aggressive intent that suggested the fans were in for a memorable afternoon of football. A Lightning Start at the Vélodrome The game exploded into life immediately, with Paris FC taking a shock lead in the 1st minute. Lassine Sinayoko found the back of the net with a clinical left-footed finish following an assist by Luca Koleosho . However, Olympique Marseille responded with incredible speed. Amine Gouiri restored parity in the 8th minute with a well-placed right-footed strike. The momentum shifted entirely just a minute later when a defensive error by Samir Chergui gifted Marseille a second goal, turning the game on its head at 2-1. The see-saw nature of the contest continued as Paris FC fought back. In the 19th minute, Lassine Sinayoko secured his second of the match, heading home from a Pablo Pagis cross. There was a brief moment of tension as the VAR reviewed the play, but the goal was officially confirmed in the 22nd minute, leaving the scores level at 2-2 as the teams headed into the break. Second Half Drama and VAR Decisiveness The intensity did not wane after the restart. In the 53rd minute, Amine Gouiri regained the lead for the home side, finishing off a move orchestrated by Amine Harit . After another VAR check, the goal was allowed to stand in the 55th minute, making it 3-2. As the clock ticked down, both managers looked to their benches, with Marseille introducing Keyliane Abdallah and Paris FC bringing on Moses Simon to inject late energy. The final turning point arrived in the 84th minute when CJ Egan-Riley was penalized for a handball in the box. Following a lengthy VAR review, the referee pointed to the spot. Lassine Sinayoko stepped up in the 86th minute to coolly slot home the penalty, completing a spectacular hat-trick. Although he received a yellow card for his shirt-off celebration, his heroics ensured a hard-fought 3-3 draw for the visitors in a match that lived up to every bit of the pre-game hype.

matches.title: Paris FC vs Nice
matches.description: Watch Paris FC vs Nice highlights and goals from Ligue 1 on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on August 30, 2026. The French capital set the stage for a compelling Ligue 1 encounter as Paris FC hosted Nice on 2026-08-30. Both teams entered the match seeking to assert their authority in the league standings, creating an atmosphere of high-stakes footballing drama. Early Pressure and the Opening Goal Paris FC began the match with intent, asserting control early on and testing the Nice defensive line. The breakthrough arrived in the 18th minute when Ilan Kebbal was brought down in the box by Youssouf Ndayishimiye . The referee immediately pointed to the spot and issued a yellow card to the Nice defender. Lassine Sinayoko stepped up to the penalty spot in the 21st minute, coolly slotting the ball home with his right foot to give the hosts a well-deserved lead. The home side continued to threaten, with Sinayoko even attempting an audacious bicycle kick just before halftime that drifted wide. Nice struggled to find their rhythm, often caught offside or forced into long-range efforts that failed to trouble the Paris FC backline. Second-Half Surge and Tactical Control Shortly after the restart, the hosts doubled their advantage. In the 51st minute, a defensive lapse by Axel Witsel allowed Paris FC to pounce. Ilan Kebbal provided his second goal-involvement of the match, setting up Samir Chergui , who finished clinically with his right foot. Nice attempted to respond by introducing fresh legs, including Elye Wahi and Isak Jansson , but the momentum remained firmly with the Parisians. Elye Wahi nearly pulled one back in the 79th minute with a powerful header, but Kevin Trapp was equal to the task, making a comfortable save. A rare moment of tension occurred when Trapp violated the 8-second rule by holding the ball too long, resulting in a corner for Nice , though the visitors failed to capitalize on the opportunity. Closing the Door at the Death As the clock ticked toward 90 minutes, Paris FC added a final flourish to their performance. In the 89th minute, a mistake by Youssouf Ndayishimiye opened the door for Vincent Marchetti . Following a key pass from Lassine Sinayoko and an assist by Patrick Zabi , Marchetti struck a left-footed shot into the net to make it 3-0. The final whistle confirmed a comprehensive victory for Paris FC , leaving Nice to reflect on a night of defensive errors and missed opportunities.
